shape: Winding S/Z-corridor (N+S gates on opposite quadrants)
description: A long winding corridor that snakes between two diagonally-opposite gates: spawn_south is in the NW quadrant (X≈-14, Z≈24), spawn_north is in the SE quadrant (X≈1, Z≈-24). The path runs SOUTH along the west wall (X=-14), bends EAST through the middle (Z≈0), then bends back NORTH along the east-center axis (X≈1) to reach the north gate. A small east-side clique (j1x8t4 + hzp49x + 8oxwey) sits where the middle meets the north arm — likely a small east-side combat pocket.

portals.north: spawn_north at (1.07, -24.40) — gate on the north (low-Z) end, east-center column
portals.south: spawn_south at (-14.04, 23.76) — gate on the south (high-Z) end, west column

anchors.description: west arm, south bend into middle row (matches ijit4z)
middle row, center hub — branches into north arm and east-side clique (matches c49qjq)
north arm staging just inside north gate (matches z11v2u)

traversalNotes: Direct S→N traversal: spawn_south → west_arm_s1 → west_arm_s2 → west_arm_s3 → middle_w → middle_c → north_arm_mid → north_arm_in → spawn_north. Eight hops along the strict-backbone S/Z winding path.
STRICT-BACKBONE on the west arm and north arm: the corridor segments between west_arm_s1 ↔ west_arm_s2 ↔ west_arm_s3 ↔ middle_w are single-file (no off-axis branches). Don't emit shortcuts.

EAST-SIDE CLIQUE: middle_c, middle_e, east_pocket, north_arm_mid form a connected sub-graph for a small east-side combat pocket. Objectives in the east half route via middle_c → (east_pocket | middle_e) → reverse.
DISPATCH RULE: south-half objectives route through the nearest west-arm anchor; east-half objectives via middle_c → east_pocket/middle_e; north-half via north_arm_mid.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
